column1: Gabriel Moreno leads the slate with a strong combination of recent consistency and a favorable matchup, making him a reliable pick to record a hit against Kyle Freeland in a hitter-friendly park. Ketel Marte and Jake McCarthy offer additional options with steady profiles, yet Moreno’s blend of form and setting stands out for Beat The Streak players.
